population.span: Patients who were 18 years of age or older (with no upper age limit) and who were hospitalized with Covid-19 pneumonia that had been confirmed by a positive polymerase-chain-reaction test and radiographic imaging were eligible for enrollment.

endpoint.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 38 of 250 patients (15.2%) in the tocilizumab group and 25 of 127 patients (19.7%) in the placebo group.

estimate.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 38 of 250 patients (15.2%) in the tocilizumab group and 25 of 127 patients (19.7%) in the placebo group.

analysis_set.span: Safety was assessed in all the patients who received either tocilizumab or placebo; patients were grouped according to the actual agent received.

treatment_strategy.span: Using permuted-block randomization and an interactive voice- or Web-response system, we randomly assigned the patients, in a 2:1 ratio, to receive standard care plus one or two doses of either intravenous tocilizumab (8 mg per kilogram of body weight, to a maximum of 800 mg per dose) or placebo.

follow_up.span: Table 3 Adverse Events through Day 60 in the Safety Population.

absent_reason.ci: No confidence interval for serious adverse events or their between-arm effect is stated in any held source.

served_mismatch: The served counts match serious adverse events, but the served analysis_set 'modified intention-to-treat' is incorrect: these counts are from the safety population grouped by actual treatment received. They apply through day 60, not to the question's 28-day all-cause mortality endpoint. No OR or corresponding CI is printed for serious adverse events.

candidate_rejections.why: Reject this analysis-set label for the served counts; retain the source-supported counts in the safety population.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Eligible participants were hospitalized adults with confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia, within the question's population.
